body.text: RTB · 2A WEEKLY INTEL · Week of Oct 19 – Oct 23, 2026
Bend held the week's attention, and the NFA question kept moving to the states.

The Bend, Oregon school shooting led all five readings (avg 93, peak 98), cooling as coverage moved to accountability and recovery. The state NFA mirror-law question held at 85-88 all week as six states gave six different answers.
